summary: EIDFJORD RUNDT (org. no. 989 829 076) is an association (FLI) based in Eidfjord, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2006-06-01. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 70.200 (Bedriftsrådgivning og annen administrativ rådgivning); it has 0 registered employees. CEO: Asle Øydvin; board chair: Asle Øydvin.
